steps: Freeze further main-branch promotion and record the failing release SHA plus UTC detection time.
In Coolify, redeploy the most recent previously validated immutable commit for xenovoya-player; never rebuild an unpinned workspace as a rollback.
Run npm run release:verify-live with XENOVOYA_EXPECTED_RELEASE_SHA set to the rollback SHA.
Confirm the player, deep link, security headers, return API, RPC, robots, sitemap, and release metadata checks pass before reopening promotion.
validation: The deployed release.json contains the exact rollback SHA and production environment.
The live release audit has no required failures.
A human verifies the home-to-play route and one safe read-only board load.
notes: Coolify credentials and server secrets are intentionally excluded. The rollback operator selects a previously validated immutable commit from deployment history.
